subject: Request: resource coverage exception for senior infra engineer
messages:
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: resource coverage exception for senior infra engineer

Hi Laura / Markus,

Quick note: Alex R. from Infra resigned effective 3/20 and the role is critical for our Dedicated serving stability work (KV cache fixes, nightly batch backfill pipeline ownership). Recruiting timeline for a senior IC is ~8–10 weeks minimum to reach offer stage. Given the production risk and upcoming Q2 launches, I think we need a temporary HC exception to backfill this seat immediately rather than wait for the general hiring queue.

Why this is urgent:
- Coverage gap hits on-call rota (1.4x on-call load for remaining infra engineers).
- Two upcoming infra projects tied to latency SLAs where Alex was primary owner.
- We already have a candidate pipeline via our vendor recruiter that can move quickly if budget/exception approved.

Proposal:
1) Approve a freeze exception for 90 days for 1 senior infra engineer (IC-3/4 equivalent).
2) Use vendor recruiter (recruiting@vendorhire.co) to surface senior candidates; use contracting bench if offer-to-start needs to be faster.
3) Offset by deferring one non-customer-facing hire this quarter (see tradeoff options attached).

I attached the filled HC exception form and a short impact summary. If we can get a decision by EOD Monday 3/9 I can commit to a vendor kickoff and first candidate screen the following week.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Manager, Platform SRE
Redwood Inference

Attachment: hc-exception-form.pdf (PDF, 24KB)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: resource coverage exception for senior infra engineer

Thanks for the context, Ben.

Two quick asks before I escalate to Finance and People Ops:
1) Can you quantify the measurable customer or revenue risk if we dont fill within 8 weeks (e.g., % increase in incident MTTR or risk of SLA breach)?
2) Which specific headcount from the org roadmap are you proposing to defer? I want the tradeoff to be explicit for exec review.

I'll hold a slot on Monday with Markus and Marissa to go through the attachment. If we can answer those two bullets today, I can route this through an expedited approval lane.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Talent & People Operations
Redwood Inference

Ben / Laura — I agree this is high risk and find the safety case compelling. Approve in principle pending tradeoff confirmation.

Counterproposal (to keep headcount neutral for the quarter):
- Defer the open ML research hire (req #ML-22) by one quarter and allocate that slot to Infra for this cycle. The ML role has lower customer-facing immediacy and can be reprioritized without immediate impact to revenue roadmaps.

I attached a short tradeoff sheet showing impact, expected delay to ML milestones, and cost delta. If Marissa confirms budget neutrality, we can mark the HC exception as approved and instruct Recruiting to proceed.

Please confirm by Monday 3/9 so we can get vendor engagement started.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Product Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: hc-tradeoff-sheet.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)

All — reviewed the tradeoff sheet and ran a quick budget pass. We can reallocate the ML headcount for Q2 and remain within the commit for the org, but two operational notes before final approval:

1) We need a short memo from Recruiting (vendor or internal) with expected cost, sign-to-start lead time, and any conversion-to-perm assumptions. That memo will be attached to the PO. Susan from TalentPartners can draft this.
2) If we go contractor-to-perm to shorten time-to-start, we need an approval for up to +10% premium on pay bands for that initial 12 weeks. I can approve that delta under existing contingent budget, but we need line manager sign-off on any extended premium.

If Laura / Markus are comfortable with the above conditions, I consider this approved and will notify Finance to reserve the slot and issue a conditional exception.

Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
